packageRules.description: Effect and its packages release together.
The e2e runner and its engines release together.
Lint and format tools release together.
The SDKs' manifests are generated, and keep the generator's ranges: a library leaves its dependencies' versions to its users.
Fern's CLI writes the committed SDKs, with the generators packages/peal-sdk/scripts/languages.ts pins: upgrade it with them, regenerating and reading the diff.
